notes:
Fixes:

- Google Drive uploads no longer fail with a "source not found" error; the companion app can read the staged archives again. (#24)
- A batch backup or restore retries an app once on a transient failure, counts apps it deliberately skips (the root manager, or an app not installed) apart from real failures, and reports a specific backup reason - archive, incomplete, or APK - instead of one generic error. (#5)
- A restore waits for the app's data directory and keeps the data owned by the app, even on a slow device; a mirror restore no longer deletes live data from an empty backup component; the install verifier is put back on the next boot if an operation is stopped before it can be re-enabled. (#5)
- The dashboard counters now include backups on a local destination (SD/USB), not only the internal store; switching to the Backups tab is faster; a long package name no longer overflows the progress line. (#34)
- A module updated ahead of the feed is never reverted: the installed versionCode floors the update engine, and a stale downgrade plan is cleared on boot.
